title: My Favorite Festivals
text: My family celebrates many festivals every year. At Lunar New Year, I get a red envelope and eat a big dinner with my family. In the summer, we cheer for boat races at the Dragon Boat Festival. In the fall, we eat mooncakes and look at the moon at the Mid-Autumn Festival. On Halloween, I wear a costume and visit houses for candy with my friends. At Christmas, we decorate a tree and give each other gifts. Every festival is a happy time to be with the people I love!
